chore(dependabot-policy): accept daily and weekly for github-actions (#1119)

## Summary

Expand step of moving the Dependabot `github-actions` check interval
from daily to weekly, so fleet repositories can switch their
`.github/dependabot.yml` one by one without failing the policy check.
Owner decision: architecture `docs/owner-decisions.md` row 386
(2026-11-23).

## Fix

- `components/dependabot-policy/policy.json`:
`scheduleIntervalByEcosystem.github-actions.accepted` is now `["daily",
"weekly"]`; `reviewed` is 2026-11-23 and `basis` records the decision.
- `README.md` and `THREAT-MODEL.md` in the component describe both
accepted values during the fleet switch.

The schema and check already accept a two-value list (existing test: "a
github-actions entry may schedule daily or weekly when its ecosystem
accepts both"), so no code changes. A later PR narrows `accepted` to
`["weekly"]`.

## Verification

- `npm run test:dependabot-policy`: 62 pass.
- `npm run lint:dependabot-policy`: passed.

## Loosened checks

- `components/dependabot-policy/policy.json`:
`scheduleIntervalByEcosystem.github-actions.accepted` goes from
`["daily"]` to `["daily", "weekly"]`, so `lint:dependabot-policy` passes
a `github-actions` entry scheduled `weekly` that it failed before. Why:
the owner decided the fleet's `github-actions` interval moves to
`weekly` by expand-then-contract (architecture `docs/owner-decisions.md`
row 386, 2026-11-23, architecture#220). Each repository switches its
`.github/dependabot.yml` in its own PR, so both values must pass until
the last one lands; the contract PR then narrows `accepted` to
`["weekly"]`, which is stricter than today.

## Related

- Owner decision row 386 in melodic-software/architecture
`docs/owner-decisions.md` (architecture#220).
- standards#1117 (basis rewrite after owner-decisions row L351).

Refs: #1101
